verifications.claim: New users can get a 7-day Apple TV+ free trial.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'New Subscriber 1 week free'; R4: 'Apple TV Standalone 7-day Free Trial'; R5: 'New Subscriber 1 week free ... after a free 7-day trial'; R6: '7-Day Free Trial ... If you haven't subscribed to Apple TV before'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm a 7-day (1 week) free trial for new subscribers.

verifications.claim: Purchasing a new iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV device offers 3 months free Apple TV+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'three months free when you buy a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV 4K, or Mac'; R2: similar; R6: 'three months ... purchasing any eligible Apple product. This includes iPhones, iPads, Macs, or Apple TV devices'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly list the exact devices and confirm 3 months free.

verifications.claim: A 1-month Apple TV+ trial is available via Apple One.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Apple One 1 month free'; R4: '30-day Apple TV Free Trial Through Apple One'; R5: 'Apple One 1 month free'; R6: '1-Month Free Trial with Apple One'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of 1-month (30-day) trial via Apple One across sources.

verifications.claim: Up to 3 months Apple TV+ free trial is available via student plans.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Student Plan ... Students get 1 month of the Apple Music Student Plan free, plus access to Apple TV'; R5: 'Students get 1 month of the Apple Music Student Plan free, plus access to Apple TV'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify 1 month for student plans, directly contradicting 'up to 3 months'.

verifications.claim: Apple TV+ is typically priced at $12.99/month after the trial ends.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'pricing will kick in at $12.99 a month'; R5: '$12.99 per month after a free 7-day trial'; R6: '$12.99 monthly subscription fee'
verifications.reasoning: Primary US sources confirm $12.99/month; R3 regional price ($6.99) does not contradict typical US pricing.

verifications.claim: The 7-Day Free Trial is a standard, direct trial for new subscribers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Apple TV Standalone 7-day Free Trial The first way to get an Apple TV free trial is directly through the app'; R6: '7-Day Free Trial ... to new subscribers'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe it as standalone/direct for new subscribers.

verifications.claim: The 3-Month Free Trial is available upon purchasing an eligible new Apple device.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'You’ll get three months free when you buy a new ... Apple product'; R3: 'New Devices 3 months free Apple TV is included for 3 months when you purchase an Apple device'; similar in others
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly support 3-month trial with new Apple device purchase.

verifications.claim: The 3-Month Free Trial must be activated within 90 days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'redeem the offer within 90 days'; R5: 'redeem the offer within 90 days'; R6: 'only good for the first 90 days after the new device is activated'

verifications.claim: The 1-Month Free Trial is included with an Apple One bundle subscription.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Apple One 1 month free Get Apple One and bundle'; R4: '30-day Apple TV Free Trial Through Apple One'; similar in R5, R6
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for 1-month trial included in Apple One bundle.

verifications.claim: The Student Trial includes 1 month free when signing up for an Apple Music student plan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Student Plan Apple Music and Apple TV Students get 1 month of the Apple Music Student Plan free, plus access to Apple TV'; R5: identical
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 1 month free Apple Music Student Plan includes Apple TV access.

verifications.claim: A valid credit/debit card must be on file.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R6: 'requires a valid email and credit/debit card'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated for 7-day trial; implied standard but not confirmed for all trials.

verifications.claim: Apple TV+ trials can be canceled at any time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'You can cancel the service any time before those seven days are up to avoid any charges'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported for the main trial; standard practice implied.

verifications.claim: Users generally keep access to Apple TV+ until the trial period ends after cancellation.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference discusses access after cancellation during trial.

verifications.claim: A 50s YouTube video by The Stream Guide published on Dec 11, 2024 explains how to get a 7-day free trial of Apple TV+.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No mention of any YouTube video or specific channel/date in sources.
